nodes.title: README: Delete Safety Note
widgets_values:
# Optional Cleanup

The delete node is intentionally left disconnected/disabled in this demo.

To test deletion safely:
1. Connect a document ID to `document_id_link`.
2. Set `confirm_delete = true`.
3. Run only that branch.
This document was processed through the color-coded standardized document workflow.

nodes.title: README: Document Workflow Instructions
widgets_values:
# ComfyUI-ZMongo Documents Demo

This workflow demonstrates the corrected, color-coded document node system.

## Core rule
Each list output contains **one semantic type only**:

- `document_ids` / `selectable_items` from document-list nodes contain document IDs only.
- `field_paths` / `selectable_items` from field-path nodes contain field paths only.
- `file_paths` from the file browser contain file paths only.

This prevents `_id`, filename, full JSON documents, and field paths from being accidentally mixed together.

## Required setup
1. Start the BPA backend with `/documents` routes enabled.
2. Install the updated `document_api_nodes.py`.
3. Install the socket color JS file under `ComfyUI-ZMongo/js/`.
4. Restart ComfyUI.

nodes.title: README: Color-Coded Connection Guide
widgets_values:
# Socket Color Guide

Use the color-coded link sockets where available.

- **Blue**: `ZMONGO_DOCUMENT_ID` → document IDs.
- **Orange**: `ZMONGO_FIELD_PATH` → dot-path field names.
- **Green**: `ZMONGO_FILE_PATH` → server-readable file paths.
- **Lime**: `ZMONGO_FILENAME` → filenames.
- **Purple**: `ZMONGO_TEXT` → text values.
- **Gold**: selectable item lists.

Use `06 Select Nth Document Item` instead of the generic selector when possible because it gives typed, color-coded outputs.

nodes.title: README: Upload a New Document
widgets_values:
# File Upload Path

`06 Document File Browser` defaults to the **Documents folder of the user running ComfyUI**:

```text
/home/comfyuser/Documents
```

Put a test PDF, TXT, MD, DOCX, RTF, CSV, or JSON file there.

Then connect:

```text
file_path_link → 06 Upload Document File.file_path_link
```

nodes.title: README: Select a Document ID
widgets_values:
# Standard Document Selection Pattern

Use this exact pattern to avoid malformed `_id` values:

```text
06 List Documents.selectable_items
  → 06 Select Nth Document Item.items_list
  → 06 Select Nth Document Item.document_id_link
  → any node's document_id_link input
```

Do **not** connect `documents_json` or `filename` outputs into a document ID field.

NOTICE OF DOCUMENT NODE DEMONSTRATION

This text document was created by the ComfyUI-ZMongo document workflow.

It demonstrates document creation, field path inspection, value retrieval, metadata updates, and text extraction.
